mainEntity.name: Do you clean during business hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. Most commercial cleaning is done before opening, after closing or overnight so customers and staff are not disrupted. Where something has to happen while you are open, we plan it with you.

mainEntity.name: Can you do a one-off deep clean before a regular contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A deep clean can be booked on its own, or as the starting point before a recurring schedule.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle floor care as well as cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Strip and wax, commercial carpet cleaning and other periodic floor care are part of what we do, and can be added to a recurring contract or booked on their own.

mainEntity.name: Are you insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The business is bonded and covered by liability insurance and WSIB Ontario, and our cleaning staff undergo background screening.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between commercial cleaning and janitorial services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Janitorial services are the routine, day-to-day upkeep of a building: trash, washrooms, kitchens, floors and touch points, on a fixed schedule. Commercial cleaning is the wider term, and also covers periodic and one-off work such as strip and wax, carpet extraction, deep cleans and post-construction clean-up. Most of our contracts are both.

mainEntity.name: How often should a commercial space be cleaned?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on how many people use it and how. Customer-facing spaces and busy washrooms are usually cleaned every day they are open; quieter areas a few times a week. We recommend a frequency at the walkthrough and put it in writing.

mainEntity.name: Who supplies washroom paper and soap?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is agreed in the proposal. We can supply and restock consumables, or restock from your own supply.

mainEntity.name: What products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use Armstrong Manufacturing's ProSeries Green line, which is third-party certified to UL Environment (ECOLOGO) standards, fragrance-free and free of VOCs.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Request a quote or call (416) 803-4880. We arrange a free on-site walkthrough and send a written proposal.
